import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for the source CSV files
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: 2017 data (no Region, but detailed 2017 metrics)
    df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Rename columns to match target suffix _17 exactly (already mostly matching)
    # Columns in df_2017: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    # 'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']

    # Load Source 1: 2015 data + Region info (different column names, need renaming)
    df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Rename columns to match target schema suffix _15 and standardize names
    df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
        'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
        'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
        'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
        'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
        'Family': 'Family_15',
        'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
        'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
        'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
        'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
        'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
    })

    # Select only needed columns from df_2015_renamed (including Region)
    df_2015_selected = df_2015_renamed[
        ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
         'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
         'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15']
    ]

    # Merge the two dataframes on 'Country'
    # We use an inner join to keep only countries present in both datasets
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_2015_selected, df_2017, on='Country', how='inner')

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = [
        'Country', 'Region',
        'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
        'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
        'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
        'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
        'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]

    df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Enforce data types as per target schema
    df_final = df_final.astype({
        'Country': str,
        'Region': str,
        'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
        'Happiness_Score_15': float,
        'Standard_Error_15': float,
        'Economy_15': float,
        'Family_15': float,
        'Life_Expectancy_15': float,
        'Freedom_15': float,
        'Trust_15': float,
        'Generosity_15': float,
        'Dystopia_15': float,
        'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
        'Happiness_Score_17': float,
        'Whisker_High_17': float,
        'Whisker_Low_17': float,
        'Economy_17': float,
        'Family_17': float,
        'Life_Expectancy_17': float,
        'Freedom_17': float,
        'Generosity_17': float,
        'Trust_17': float,
        'Dystopia_17': float
    })

    # Save the final dataframe to the target CSV file
    df_final.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
